descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S23 「UAT 部署上 Vikram 的 Convex dashboard：同样的行，不用人帮就能过滤和读懂」 Vikram's Convex dashboard on the UAT deployment: the same rows, filtered and read without help

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize …（UAT OAT-06 closing line；TFA-94514 AC 8；TFA-94609 AC 5；TFA-94609 AC 6）
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex（UAT OAT-06 Test 6；TFA-94514 AC 6）
  • T1 Engineering prepares a simple hand-off doc so Vikram knows how to access the analytics data（TFA-94514 AC 9）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given The UAT (deployed) build after a QA physician has done S01, S07 and S15's steps; Vikram's or Tim's existing dashboard access

When Open Data -> pilotDailyRounding, filter userId and day; open pilotUsageEvents, patientActivityEvents, surveyResponses; follow the hand-off doc

Then Every event from the steps is there with the same values as the local run; notes generated, handoffs sent and the open-to-complete time for that physician and day can be read and the average worked out from the doc; no new UI or endpoint was needed

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-06 closing line; the reader confirms in writing. Done by Tim/Vikram, never by this agent (dev is out of bounds); Q12. An @roundai.test account only, never the store-review account; owner Tim

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：CONFIG · 配置核对；辅助：EXPLORATORY · 探索测试 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
